generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The tenderer has to quote his rate by excluding GST. However contract will be concluded for the AMOUNT (Exclusive of GST) but Applicable GST will be paid extra prevailing at the time of execution.If the GST rates are revised during the contract period, the Tenderer/Employer has to accept the revised GST rates for making payment/recovery

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The intending Bidder/ firm/ company are advised to visit the work site before submission of the tenders.

The necessary Certifcates / documents in support of eligibility criteria fulflled as stipulated shall be scanned and attached to e- tender document. The original certificate / documents shall be produced prior to the opening of bid for verification. Scanned signature of the Bidder/ firm/ company authorized representative of the Bidder/ firm/ company shall be attached while uploading bid document.
If any of the dates mentioned above happens to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good
Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever.
Corrigendum will be published in the website for all modifications or corrections if any
The contractor should mention their recent correct postal address & mail address in declaration forms
All materials like steel, cement etc., required for the above work should be procured by the contractor only. No departmental supply of any materials shall be made by Department
The contractor should adhere to the accepted execution plan submitted by him under any circumstances without linking to the pending payment of the work & also Land acquisition problems if any
Typographical errors, if any, will not be the ground for any claims by the Contractor.

The necessary Certificates / documents in support of eligibility criteria fulfilled as stipulated shall be scanned and attached to e- tender document. The original certificate / documents shall be produced for verification when demanded, otherwise the tender will be treated as non responsive bid and rejected
Scanned signature of the Bidder/ firm/ company authorized representative of the Bidder/ firm/ company shall be attached while uploading bid document.
Incomplete tender documents will be rejected
As per the Karnataka Building and other Constructions Workers Welfare Cess Act 1996, 1% of the bill amount will be deducted from the bills.
The contractor should adhere to the accepted execution plan submitted by him under any circumstances without linking to the pending payment of the work.
The contractor should furnish the name of the individual / firm / company with address & telephone No with place of registration, year of incorporation etc

Original documents shall be produced for verification at the any stage of tender process, Failure to produce original documents will lead to disqualification. work done certificate should have all the details CR no, work order issuing date, work completion date and year as asked in bid document
Restrictions on Public Procurement from Bidders of certain countries as per Government order No. FD 455 Exp-12 2020 Bengaluru dated:01-04-2023

During the execution of works, if any minor minerals are required, contractors have to abide by the prevailing rules and Acts applicable to Minor Minerals. As per the prevailing rules, for any use of Minor Minerals, the contractor has to submit the mineral Dispatch Permit (MDP) obtained from Mines and Geology Department. If mineral Dispatch permit (MDP) is not submitted by the contractor along with the bill, the prevailing penalty DMF contribution as per Karnataka Minor Mineral Concession Rules 1994 (as amended from time to time) will be deducted from the contractors bill

The agencies participating in the tender shall be registered in the Construction Labor Board as per the G.O. No. LD 300 LET 2006 Dated:18-1-2007 and Addendum No. LD 95 LET 2013 Bengaluru Dt:1-4-2013. Also the contractors entrusted with the work shall employ the labors only who have registered in the Karnataka Building and Construction Workers Welfare Board failing which the contractor shall be liable for any further action as deem fit by the authority.

Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any of the forms as mentioned in bid document for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with Clause 25.5 of ITT and Clause 44 of the Conditions of Contract for all works.

The contractor has to make his own arrangements for procurement of all the required materials and the materials so procured shall confirm to the relevant IS Specifications and obtain necessary quality certificate from authorized quality control.

The Contractor is fully responsible for the Equipment / Material until the same is handed over to the EXECUTIVE ENGINEER in an operating condition after commissioning. The Contractor is responsible for the proper maintenance of equipment / material as well as protection of the same against theft, elements of nature, damages etc., while in his custody as well as after erection until the same is taken over by the EXECUTIVE ENGINEER under due acknowledgment in writing.
The tenderer shall also disclose if there are any bankruptcy proceedings against him

The Work Done Certificates shall be issued by the Executive Engineer with indent number mentioned (if work done in Karnataka State), otherwise it shall be issued/counter signed by Superintending Engineer (if the work is done in other states).
Sub-Leasing/G.P.A of Work is Prohibited
Each Item Of BOQ To be read as with all lead and lifts and including loading and unloading charges and all other charges and as per the direction of Engineer in charge.
Uploaded drawings are for TENDER PURPOSE ONLY.

The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the work listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent
Income Tax : Latest copy of the Income Tax Clearance Certificate and Sale Tax Clearance PAN and TAN Nos. to be uploaded
It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee into the respective receiving bank accounts of KPPP Portal on or before the last date and time of bid submission
The tender processing charges paid by the bidder/ firm/ company are not refundable even if the tenders are cancelled
All other terms and conditions as per KW-3 tender documents.

itemList.description:
Supplying of spare parts to 200 HP oil lubricated DWT pump to facilitate from the site to workshop by removing motor turbine base, tee joint, column pipes, line shaft and bowl assembly etc., Complete, supplying of spare parts to bowl assembly by providing and fixing of gun metal casted, machining, turning, boring and finishing for required sizes and fixing of suction and discharge case bearing, interstage case bearing, supplying of spare parts to trueness and truing of bowl assembly stainless shaft with S.S welding, turning, maching for orginal dimensions of the shaft, supplying of spare parts to trueness and trueing the impeller including inner finishing for shaft sizes and externally machining to requied sizes, supplying of spare parts to the TT nut with replacing new GM bush, supplying of spare parts to stuffing box by means of boring, turing, and internally left hand thearding for oil tube sizes, supplying of spare to gland rope for TT nut, supplying of spare parts to adopter screw gun metal bearing including cost of new gun metal bush and machining for bowl assembly shaft sizes, supplying of spare parts to line shaft of all sizes including welding and turning for required sizes, supplying of spare parts to oil tubes by cutting both ends of each 5 ft length oil tube including jionting of new MS tubes suitable for oil tubes with internally left hand turning for bearing sizes, supplying of spare parts to oil lubricated gun metal bearings suitable pattern casted internally machining and finishing fot line shaft sizes and externally turning machining and left hand treading as per the sample original bearing supplying of spare parts to bolts and nuts packing rubber gland rope etc,. jointing materials after attending all repairs same as to facilited from work shope to site and re errection of pump after attending job works including assembling all the parts with errection and trail running ect,. The pumps are old, pumps are struck up/ Failed for the lift the water every year due to struck, in impeller, damages in colum pipe, shaft, oil seals, rubber bush, gun metal, bowl assembly and others so far previous records pumps are probably failed Hence 3 pumps are consider for repairs and recondition in every season of the year.
No of pumps in the scheme 3 Nos as directed by engineer in charge.

Supplying of spare parts nad repair re conditioning, trail running of 10 inch sizes sluice valve including dismentaling and fecilete from site work to work shop by removing from delivery end of T joint including supply of  spare parts gun metal bushs hingers shop, stainless steel square thredding shaft square thredding shaft gum metal nut guld ring to tongue suitable sizes, paking rubber bolt and nuts with washers of required sizes, and othe jointing material the involves this melting nessesery repals including thredding, streting, turning, machining, finishing etc,. complete with attending all nessesery job works including assembling all the parts with errection and trail running etc,. complete as directed by engineer in charge.

Supplying of spare parts nad repair re conditioning, trail running of 10 inch sizes N.R. valve including dismentaling and fecilete from site work to work shop by removing from delivery end of T joint including supply of  spare parts gun metal bushs hingers shop, stainless steel square thredding shaft square thredding shaft gum metal nut guld ring to tongue suitable sizes, paking rubber bolt and nuts with washers of required sizes, and othe jointing material the involves this melting nessesery repals including thredding, streting, turning, machining, finishing etc,. complete with attending all nessesery job works including assembling all the parts with erection and trail running etc,. complete

Supplying spare parts to Foot Valve for maintanance to facilitate from site to workshop for Reconditioning of Foot Valve. Tongue pins are replace by making new pins with SS shaft, Tongue Gun metal bushes are replaced by new gun metal bushes with machining for required sizes, providing and fixing of new foot valve leather, providing and fixing of packing rubber, supplying of bolts and nuts, catrol grease for the foot valve, after attending all repairs same has to facilitate from workshop to site and Re erection of Foot valve after attending job works including assembling all the parts with erection and trail running etc, Complete as directed by engineer in charge.

Winding of 200 HP DWT 3 phase induction motor Kirloskar/ Jothi/ Croption greaves make motor with 'B' class insulating materials such as triple papers, emperor cloth, cotton rape, varnish (oil) air dry, fiber glass sleeves, legs stripping with 7/16 end connection and suitable for above motor HTP (ISI) make class-1 working  with 100 degree C heat gauge enamel coated and insulating copper winding wire required as per original make. Labour charges to lifiting and the above motor including transporation charges from site to workshop and return to site and overolling and trail run at site etc,. Complete in the direction of incharge Engineer.

Supplying starter spares for 200 Amps air brake ATS starter replacement of suitable contacts on volt coil, timer, pushing timer, pilot lamp, amps meter and volt meter, turnel plate, push botton, MCB, Bassbar plate, a/m plates, 716 flexible copper pvc coated wire 3 If contacter for suitable HP, tripping relay unit, CT relaying, CT coil, HRC fuse function etc,. And complete with all lead and lifts including loading and unloading as per the directions of Engineer-in-charge of work.

Supplying and spare materials suitable providing of L&T make OCB base plate with studs etc,. Complete providing & fixing contacts for OCB and providing of moving copper contacts or providing of novelts copper coils with cour (3 Nos) and providing of bakelite buses for study in OCB, providing and fixing of 100 sq.mm copper lugs (cripping) or wonder make RYB steel grip pvc tape and steel tension blade. On volt coil with OCB required oil and labour charges for dismantling and reassembly the OCB unit with new parts, repairing for connecting with load condition and filling complete job as directed by engineer in charge.
Transformer oil as directed by engineer in charge.
SAE 10 OIL as directed by engineer in charge.
Grease GEM RR3 as directed by engineer in charge.

De-silting in tank bed/Feeder Channel/Canal in dry condition by excavating the deposited bed material and disposing off the same by stacking/ formation of Embankment or as directed including cost of all machinery, labour & all necessary works as directed and complete as per specification as directed by engineer in charge.

Distempering with dry distemper of approved brand and manufacture (two coats) of required shade on new work, over and including water thinnable priming coat to give an even shade after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.
